Private bundle client state, metrics, and gRPC reconnect and subscription callbacks.

# Purpose
This header defines the private state and internal interfaces for the bundle client tile. It declares `fd_bundle_tile_t`, which stores connection settings, DNS and TCP state, keepalive and RTT tracking, gRPC client data, bundle authentication state, subscription flags, backoff control, and metrics. It also declares helper functions for reconnect handling, periodic housekeeping, gRPC receive callbacks, status reporting, reset, and PING transmission. The file is used as an internal contract between the tile logic and the callback code that drives bundle server communication.
